prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of Xun Yu from the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — Cao Cao's great adviser, the 'talent to assist a king'. Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags. She is a woman — no beard, moustache or facial hair.

Style (fixed): Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.

World (fixed): Cao Wei in northern China, around 200–235 AD: the walled capitals of Xuchang, Ye and Luoyang, rammed-earth ramparts and tiled watchtowers, black-and-navy banners over vast northern plains, armoured cavalry, bronze ritual vessels and lacquered halls. Her costume, weapon and setting belong to this world.

Weapon (fixed — ours): an incense burner of bronze.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): deep ink-blue hair. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Skin tone (fixed — ours): warm beige skin. Keep exactly this skin tone.

Costume colours (ours): deep navy blue, black lacquer, cold steel silver, ivory white.

Rank (fixed): she is a high court official — her costume must read dignified office at first glance: refined, layered and finely ornamented, with flagship-card detail, never plain or sparse.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin — never a long face or a long, pointed or heavy jaw; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline and never lengthens her face. Her eyes stay at a natural open size — never squeezed into narrow slits.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her crown or headpiece to both boots stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every genre; her hands and her signature item stay inside the frame. Camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective — no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

Costume selection: layered trailing court regalia with a tall crown, long hanging sashes and jade pendants — a ceremonial, stately silhouette. Construct the layered ivory lapels and navy skirt panels as nested curves resembling the winding path of incense rising through a bronze censer, using cut and overlap rather than printed patterns. A refined high official's robes with a deep neckline, bare shoulders, and a high side slit. Her deep ink-blue hair is in a braided high bun with two soft cheek locks; amber eyes, a compact heart-shaped face, softly arched brows, rose lips and a subtle knowing smile. She stands front-facing with her weight naturally balanced, cradling the bronze incense burner in both hands at waist level. Setting: a Han palace's open garden corridor, carved stone balustrade, bamboo beyond, clear morning light.

One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; a banner or seal may carry a single faction character, no other text; no logo or watermark.
